prompts.name: recipe-morning-regime-brief
prompts.title: Morning regime brief
prompts.description: Give me a morning regime brief: dealer gamma flip, call wall and put wall for SPY, QQQ and IWM, plus where the VIX is. One batch call fetches gamma exposure for the three index ETFs; a second reads the VIX. The script prints spot, net dealer gamma, the flip level and the call and put walls per symbol, then says which regime each is in: positive gamma damps moves, negative gamma amplifies them.
prompts.returns: One batch call fetches gamma exposure for the three index ETFs; a second reads the VIX. The script prints spot, net dealer gamma, the flip level and the call and put walls per symbol, then says which regime each is in: positive gamma damps moves, negative gamma amplifies them.
prompts.template: Give me a morning regime brief: dealer gamma flip, call wall and put wall for {ticker}, {ticker_b} and IWM, plus where the VIX is.

prompts.name: recipe-earnings-week-straddles
prompts.title: Earnings-week straddles
prompts.description: Which large caps report earnings this week, and how does each one's implied move compare with its usual move? Reads the next seven days of the earnings calendar, keeps the largest names, and prints the straddle-implied move beside the historical average move and the ratio between them. A ratio well above one says the market is paying up for the event; well below one says the event is cheap against its own history.
prompts.returns: Reads the next seven days of the earnings calendar, keeps the largest names, and prints the straddle-implied move beside the historical average move and the ratio between them. A ratio well above one says the market is paying up for the event; well below one says the event is cheap against its own history.
prompts.template: Which large caps report earnings this week, and how does each one's implied move compare with its usual move?

prompts.name: recipe-watchlist-iv-rank-screen
prompts.title: Watchlist IV rank screen
prompts.description: Rank my watchlist by IV rank and tell me which names are expensive or cheap against their own year: NVDA, AMD, TSLA, AVGO, MU, PLTR, COIN, NFLX, CRWD, SMCI. One batch call returns IV rank, IV percentile and the current 30-day implied vol for up to 25 symbols. The script sorts the list, flags the names above 50 and below 20, and prints what each one's implied vol is against its own year.
prompts.returns: One batch call returns IV rank, IV percentile and the current 30-day implied vol for up to 25 symbols. The script sorts the list, flags the names above 50 and below 20, and prints what each one's implied vol is against its own year.
prompts.template: Rank my watchlist by IV rank and tell me which names are expensive or cheap against their own year: {ticker}, {ticker_b}, TSLA, AVGO, MU, PLTR, COIN, NFLX, CRWD, SMCI.

prompts.name: recipe-vrp-ranker
prompts.title: VRP ranker
prompts.description: Rank AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, AMD, TSLA and AMZN by volatility risk premium, and tell me which ones only look expensive because of an earnings gap. Calls the volatility risk premium endpoint for each symbol and ranks them by the gap between 30-day implied vol and the realized vol of the last 30 sessions. The ex-earnings realized figure is printed beside it, because one earnings gap in the window can make a cheap name look expensive.
prompts.returns: Calls the volatility risk premium endpoint for each symbol and ranks them by the gap between 30-day implied vol and the realized vol of the last 30 sessions. The ex-earnings realized figure is printed beside it, because one earnings gap in the window can make a cheap name look expensive.
prompts.template: Rank {ticker}, {ticker_b}, NVDA, AMD, TSLA and AMZN by volatility risk premium, and tell me which ones only look expensive because of an earnings gap.

prompts.name: recipe-zero-dte-levels
prompts.title: 0DTE levels
prompts.description: Give me today's SPY 0DTE levels: gamma regime, flip, call and put walls, max pain and the expected range. Reads the 0DTE analytics for SPY and prints the levels a day trader marks first: the net gamma regime, the flip level, the call and put walls, max pain, and the one standard deviation range from the at-the-money straddle. It also prints the feed's IV forecast against the implied figure and the historical hit rate of the expected move.
prompts.returns: Reads the 0DTE analytics for SPY and prints the levels a day trader marks first: the net gamma regime, the flip level, the call and put walls, max pain, and the one standard deviation range from the at-the-money straddle. It also prints the feed's IV forecast against the implied figure and the historical hit rate of the expected move.
prompts.template: Give me today's {ticker} 0DTE levels: gamma regime, flip, call and put walls, max pain and the expected range.

prompts.name: recipe-term-structure-watch
prompts.title: Term structure watch
prompts.description: Show me the implied vol term structure for SPY, NVDA and TSLA and tell me which one is in backwardation. Fetches the implied vol term structure for each symbol and compares the nearest expiration's at-the-money vol with the furthest one returned. A front month above the back is backwardation, usually an event or stress; the script prints the slope in vol points and per-expiry straddle prices for the first few expirations.
prompts.returns: Fetches the implied vol term structure for each symbol and compares the nearest expiration's at-the-money vol with the furthest one returned. A front month above the back is backwardation, usually an event or stress; the script prints the slope in vol points and per-expiry straddle prices for the first few expirations.
prompts.template: Show me the implied vol term structure for {ticker}, {ticker_b} and TSLA and tell me which one is in backwardation.

prompts.name: recipe-flow-unusual-today
prompts.title: Unusual flow today
prompts.description: What unusual options activity is there in NVDA today, and what is the call versus put premium split? Reads the options flow for one symbol and prints the summary line (call and put volume, premium and the sentiment read) followed by the unusual rows, sorted by premium. Volume far above open interest is what marks a print as unusual; the script shows both so the reader can judge.
prompts.returns: Reads the options flow for one symbol and prints the summary line (call and put volume, premium and the sentiment read) followed by the unusual rows, sorted by premium. Volume far above open interest is what marks a print as unusual; the script shows both so the reader can judge.
prompts.template: What unusual options activity is there in {ticker} today, and what is the call versus put premium split?

prompts.name: recipe-portfolio-greeks-check
prompts.title: Portfolio Greeks check
prompts.description: I am long 100 SPY and short one 30-delta put in the nearest monthly expiration. What are my net Greeks, and how does the book do in a 10 percent drop with vol up 50 percent? Builds a two-position book from live quotes (long stock plus a short 30-delta put priced from the chain), posts it to the portfolio Greeks endpoint, then runs the stress tests. The output is the net Greeks, the risk label, and the estimated profit and loss in each crash, rally and vol-shock scenario.
prompts.returns: Builds a two-position book from live quotes (long stock plus a short 30-delta put priced from the chain), posts it to the portfolio Greeks endpoint, then runs the stress tests. The output is the net Greeks, the risk label, and the estimated profit and loss in each crash, rally and vol-shock scenario.
prompts.template: I am long 100 {ticker} and short one 30-delta put in the nearest monthly expiration. What are my net Greeks, and how does the book do in a 10 percent drop with vol up 50 percent?
